 # fill rectangle bounded by matching horizontal endpoint bars
 pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
 # task-specific marker color is 1; fill bbox
 r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts); c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
 for r in range(r0,r1+1):
  for c in range(c0,c1+1): g[r][c]=4 if grid[r][c] not in (3,1) else 1
 return g
